description: Vestiaire Collective listing tracker (US site, USD): for 1-10 listing IDs (the number before .shtml in a listing URL) returns title, brand, category, condition, color, material, current price, seller price and buyer fee, sold / reserved / available flags, likes, seller country, listed items and items sold, shipping origin and URL. Reads each public listing page; no catalog search. Related tools on this server, for a different need: ecommerce_costco when you need Costco Canada product tracker: for 1-5 product IDs returns; ecommerce_faire when you need Faire wholesale marketplace category listing: product. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

ids.description: Comma-separated listing IDs or listing URLs, 1 to 10, e.g. 72610431 (required)
